The girl smiles at you. "I've always been fascinated with Greek mythology." She glances at her reflection in the mirror. "My room mate helped me make this.  She's a theatrical major and gets a lot of experience working with costumes.  I understand her professor is a little on the cheap side so they often just have to make do."
 
That rings true to your ears, having taken some creative arts classes before.
 
 
>tell girl about theater
"I took theater for a couple of semesters and also remember Dr. Davidson being particularly budget conscious."
 
 
"So you came out of acting class with some experience making theater costumes," she says.  You watch her eyes look over your costume as though assessing your skills.
 
>tell girl about Dracula costume
"Dracula was always my favorite monster," you say, glancing at one of your many reflections.
 
 
"I used to stay up late at night and watch vampire shows with my father when I was a little girl.  At least I did when he wasn't working."
 
You grimace. "Not exactly Sesame Street."
 
She shrugs.  "It's true.  I was too young to be watching those kinds of shows.  Vampires scare me even today."

You have nothing, except a devouring illness.
 
- My little dear one, something is rotten in the House of Pudlo. -
 
His voice rings somehow out of synch with the movements of his mouth and jaw. The impression of artificiality is reinforced by his unblinking eyes in which you see your miniature reflection, as if looking in the reversed end of a telescope.
 
- You must revenge my foul and most unnatural murder! -
 
- Murder? - you exclaim. He beckons you to silence. - Yes, my dear boy, that shameless, that adulterate beast known to you as "Mother" has murdered me in connivance with Jacek, with whom she has been indulging in fornication since Shabbat Shekalim. -

- The Babylonian Whore - he continues, flecks of foam appearing in the corners of his mouth - had applied a poisonous ointment to the sides of my chamber-pot. With a consuming rash, the poison scaled the delicate skin of my derrière and curdled my blood. The vile nature of the resulting concoction can not be described, so vile it was, only alluded to, and that only by comparing it to a mixture of red wine and sour milk.-
 
With his arms raised in a theatrical gesture, as if summoning the stars to bear witness, he exclaims:
 
- O, Adonai Hashem, be not silent! She has spoken to me with lying tongues and repaid me evil for good and hatred for love. Raise up a vengeful angel and let it tear out her eyes and heart so that her shrieks may untie the knot of evil and close up her filthy cunt! -
 
The vehement gesture raises the hem of his shirt giving you an unsolicited glimpse of his hair-darkened buttocks. Realising the unseemliness of his new stance, he resumes the bending posture and (clasping his hands on his genitals) faces you anew.
